labels.name: Liam Gallagher (founded own label for this project)

podcast.title: High Investment and Producer (2010)
podcast.body: Liam Gallagher initiated the Bedi project by founding his own record label and spending a "fortune" to recruit Steve Lillywhite, one of the most important and expensive producers in the United Kingdom, known for his work with U2, to ensure a prominent return to the music scene. "liamgala guerr funda su propia discográfica para este nuevo proyecto y no solo eso sino que coge a Steve Lily Wipe que es uno de los productores más importantes y más caros del reino unido que ha trabajado con gente como youtube, en el que se gasta una auténtica millonada para hacer un poco una vuelta por todo lo alto."

srcs.episode: OASIS: Repasamos la historia de su separación.

podcast.title: Humiliating Concert Performance
podcast.body: A concert performance by Bedi was described as "one of the most humiliating concerts that we have had in modern music," indicating a significant disappointment in their live shows despite the high expectations. "fue uno de los conciertos yo creo que más humillantes que hemos tenido la música moderna."
